title: thalictrum minus var. petrosum
intro: Thalictrum minus var. petrosum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include pain relief, wound healing, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
